title: Hardware Procurement Returns and Restocking Schedule
content:
## Return terms for unwanted units, by order type

The Hardware Procurement return window is counted in calendar days after delivery. Restocking fees are stated as a percentage of the returned units' unit price.

| Order type | Return window (calendar days after delivery) | Restocking fee, unopened units (percent of unit price) | Opened resaleable units accepted as unwanted returns | Restocking fee, accepted opened units (percent of unit price) | Order is non-returnable except dead on arrival |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accessory & Peripheral Order | 30 | 15 | Yes | 25 | No |
| Standard Endpoint Order | 30 | 15 | No | 0 | No |
| Staged Endpoint Order | 30 | 20 | No | 0 | No |
| Network Equipment Order | 15 | 20 | No | 0 | No |
| Server & Storage Build Order | 15 | 25 | No | 0 | No |
| Special-Order Equipment | 0 | 100 | No | 0 | Yes |

## Terms common to every order type

| Term | Every order type |
|---|---|
| Staging fee of returned units credited | No |
| Handling fee credited on a return | No |
| Units received back damaged credited | No |

## Points of reading

- Opened resaleable units are accepted as unwanted returns only on an Accessory & Peripheral Order, at a restocking fee of 25 percent; on every other order type an opened unit is not an accepted unwanted return, and its opened-unit fee is shown as 0 for that reason.
- Special-Order Equipment is non-returnable except dead on arrival, with a return window of 0 days.
- Hypothetical illustration: two unopened Staged Endpoint units at a unit price of 1000.00 are 2000.00 of returned value, and the 20 percent restocking fee on it is 400.00.
